scripts.migrate: pnpm --filter @cinewren/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: pnpm run migrate && pnpm --filter @cinewren/worker exec wrangler deploy --config ../../wrangler.jsonc

CREDENTIAL_KEYS.description: Encrypts origin credentials: a JSON map of key version to a base64 32-byte key. Generate with: printf '{"1":"%s"}' "$(openssl rand -base64 32)". Back it up offline; it cannot be recovered (docs/operations/self-host.md).

SETUP_TOKEN.description: One-time token for first-run /setup. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32 | tr "+/" "-_" | tr -d "=". Delete it after creating the operator.
